blockers.detail: A representative anonymised Koha export is needed. Synthetic fixtures do not establish how a real library’s framework maps.
An interactive Windows desktop and a network-disabled test session are needed for the desktop acceptance run.
A physical printer and USB keyboard-wedge scanner are needed to check printed output and scan accuracy.

verificationRuns.title: Staff recovery, inventory and dashboard verification
verificationRuns.check: cargo test --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; npm test -- --maxWorkers 2; npm run build; npm run lint
verificationRuns.result: 102 Rust unit, 13 Tauri IPC and 97 frontend tests passed. Verified one-use staff recovery, session revocation, saved stock checks, transfer receive/cancel and restart persistence, member pagination and expiry, and dashboard hold counts. The final UI suite also checked stock-check scanning and explicit restore confirmation.

verificationRuns.title: Windows native startup retry
verificationRuns.check: Build isolated custom-protocol executable and launch with a disposable app-data path
verificationRuns.result: Build passed. The Windows launch returned Access is denied (OS error 5) and never produced a WebView page-load marker. Native circulation, restoration and printing remain open.

verificationRuns.title: Backups, recovery and audit log checks
verificationRuns.check: cargo test --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; npm run build; npm run lint; npm test -- --maxWorkers 2

verificationRuns.title: Member report verification

verificationRuns.result: 90 tests passed. The report displayed two currencies and preserved an amount above the JavaScript safe-integer range. Build and lint passed.

verificationRuns.result: Four checks passed: weighted scores and 100% endpoint, schema and evidence validation, loopback HTTP and error recovery, and DOM rendering with real three-second polling and retained filters.

verificationRuns.result: Edge could not initialize its GPU process. The Chrome UI session stopped at the browser URL access check. Desktop and mobile visual review and an adapter-disabled browser run remain open. All monitor assets and data were served on loopback, and the DOM check allows only loopback data requests.
